aircraft._commentFlaps: No aircraft-specific flap detents are configured: airbus-base intentionally does not assert shared Airbus flap notches. Add A320neo V2-specific detents only after vendor documentation or in-sim verification.

aircraftCfg._comment: The A20N designator is only accepted when both the title and creator identify the Microsoft/iniBuilds A320neo V2, preventing legacy Asobo, FlyByWire, and Fenix A320 variants from matching.

lvars._comment: The exact-profile adapter owns 11 native FCU/FD subscriptions plus one gauge A-var voltage subscription. Generic FCU targets remain secondary confirmation only; the aircraft page displays native selector values.

controls._comment: 42 guarded actions over 55 fields, 34 confirmation/guard fields, 27 standard event IDs and five native LVAR writes. Four FCU target actions require fresh native and independent standard target agreement; captain FD uses native state. These six actions are partial after independent parked MSFS 2024 acceptance. Remaining standard controls are untested. No generic fallback, AP1/AP2, managed/selected push-pull, FLC, spoiler, runway-turnoff or deep-system writes.

meta.notes: Microsoft / iniBuilds Airbus A320neo V2: 55 fields, 42 actions, 34 confirmation/guard fields and 12 gauge subscriptions. Four native FCU targets and captain FD were independently checked in this exact aircraft on MSFS 2024 1.8.16.0, powered and parked. Other controls and flight behavior remain unvalidated. See docs/AIRCRAFT-ONBOARDING-SESSION-2026-10-02.md.

sources.name: FlightFabric independent A320neo V2 parked control acceptance
sources.notes: Reproducible observation via the documented MSFS SimConnect/gauge interface, not vendor-published mapping documentation. L:INI_Airspeed_Dial (knots), L:INI_HEADING_DIAL (degrees), L:INI_Altitude_Dial (feet), L:INI_vvi_dial (feet/minute) each changed both the physical FCU display and the independent standard target, then restored. L:INI_FD1_ON (Bool 0/1) changed only the captain FD button and restored. Native mode readings INI_managed_speed, INI_FCU_SPD_DASHED, INI_FCU_HDG_DOT, INI_FCU_HDG_DASHED, INI_TRACK_FPA_STATE and INI_FCU_VS_DASHED were zero in the tested selected state; managed/TRK/FPA transitions are not accepted. A:ELECTRICAL MAIN BUS VOLTAGE is read through the gauge bridge. Community HubHop presets supplied candidates; only the limited independently observed behavior is claimed.

knownIssues: Exact live TITLE A320neo V2 and configuration SimObjects\Airplanes\microsoft-a320neo\presets\inibuilds\a20n\config\aircraft.CFG matched this profile. Independent evidence: docs/AIRCRAFT-ONBOARDING-SESSION-2026-10-02.md.
Only powered, parked selected FCU targets and captain FD have cockpit acceptance in MSFS 2024 1.8.16.0. Other variants, MSFS 2020 and airborne guidance remain unvalidated.

FCU actions need fresh native and standard target agreement. Native write echo alone cannot confirm a command. The page uses native selectors because changing altitude can change generic VS to -700 while the displayed/native selector remains zero.
Managed, dashed, Mach and TRK/FPA states are excluded by guards but their live transition coverage is incomplete. No managed/selected push-pull controls or AP1/AP2 channel semantics are asserted.
Captain FD uses INI_FD1_ON; first-officer FD is not controlled. Standard TOGGLE_FLIGHT_DIRECTOR could change a generic flag without changing the cockpit on A320neo V2.

Remaining standard flight-guidance, lighting, gear/flap and parking-brake actions retain untested status. Lamp output alone does not prove native multi-position switch state; AUTO, runway-turnoff and spoiler writes remain excluded.
Main bus voltage can show transient initialization values before Ready to fly. Wait for stable aircraft initialization and visible FCU power before live acceptance.
No aircraft-specific flap detents or deep-system writes are asserted. Native mappings are version-specific observed behavior, not a supported vendor SDK contract.
